constraints.name: character_set_binary
constraints.description: The string S consists only of characters '0' and '1'.

objective.description: Compute the number of 1 bits in the XOR of all K-length substrings of a binary string

invariants.name: prefix_sum_conservation
invariants.description: The prefix sum array dp maintains the property that each element dp[i] equals the sum of the first i+1 elements of the original binary array. This allows any consecutive range sum to be computed as the difference between two prefix sums, which is exploited to compute the parity of ones in the interval corresponding to each bit of the result.
